components.gap: Narrowed variant of a source claim. Hoeffding (p.~20) states that the bound (2.8), i.e. B_1, 'is an increasing function of sigma^2' (his 'increases' on p.~22 is strict: it yields dG/dt>0 if and only if t>1-2mu). The entry states and proves only that B_1 is nondecreasing in sigma^2 (variance-and-dependent-concentration.tex 230; annex 343-346, where the infimum of increasing envelopes is concluded to be nondecreasing). Supply the source's strict increase of B_1 in sigma^2 with written steps (for example from f_c'>0 in thm:p15-variance-moment-concavity and the attained minimizer h_* of the tail proof), cited at p.~20.

defect_observations: Source slip not recorded: Lemma 2 (p.~23) says 'A proof of this inequality can be found in Bennett [1]', but item [1] of the list (p.~29) is Bahadur and Rao; Bennett is [2]. The handbook flags the analogous Doob [7]/[4] slip (variance-and-dependent-concentration.tex 148-151) but not this one; its annex (40-41) alludes to Bennett's proof only.

variance-and-dependent-concentration.tex 673-679 (example 3) assumes independent identically distributed observations for the Kendall kernel; the source's example (p.~25) needs only independent vectors with continuous distributions. thm:p15-one-sample-u-concentration already covers the independent case, so this is a needless narrowing of the example, not a missing case.

Further-reading pointers not reproduced and not counted as gaps: 'Other examples of U statistics can be found in reference [8]' (p.~25) and 'Other examples of two-sample U statistics can be found in [9]' (p.~26).

Source slip: p.~20 says rho(x)>x/6 gives 'a lower bound for B_1/B_2'; it gives a lower bound for phi, i.e. an upper bound for B_1/B_2, which is what variance-and-dependent-concentration.tex 177-180 states.

Prohorov's name for (2.14) appears only as the example label B_Prohorov (variance 663) and in the annex (148); the theorem statement (68-99) introduces h_3 without naming Prohorov. Present on the route, weakly.
